126 plants. Bars are the midpoint of the published range; the range is printed beside each bar.
Share of the ESSENTIAL OIL, not of the plant. Chemotype moves these more than species does.

rect.title: alpha-asarone: up to about 16.8% in the highest Indian genotype% of the oil

beta-asarone: highly variable: commonly cited as low (5-19%) in older European-focused reviews, but a 2009 Indian study found most accessions triploid with 82.0-89.4% beta-asarone in the oil, with one outlier at 11.55%% of the oil
